claim: Google's own reporting shows how accounting method changes the story: market-based data-centre energy emissions fell 12% in 2024 even while location-based Scope 2 emissions nearly doubled between 2020 and 2024.
shortLabel: Market-based and location-based tell different stories
comparisonContext: This is why the carbon story must distinguish accounting method from physical grid impact and long-run grid emissions trends.
scopeNote: Different accounting methods answer different questions; they should not be collapsed into one trend line.
